cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Just Say Yes
cards.instruction: Get a quick approval before anyone has time to examine the practical consequences.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Quick yes to the garden party before the booking expires?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Let's secure the date, then count chairs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll fetch the quote while you say yes. That way we won't lose the booking while you're reading it.

mechanism: A controls when practical questions may be asked so B must give quick approval before receiving the guest count or cost.
confusable: D04 seeks approval after action; this pair seeks approval before scrutiny and uses A rank to sequence scrutiny after commitment.
comparison: A booking deadline pressures garden-party consent; the sofa scene uses an arriving delivery to accelerate a nod before measurement.
seedUse: The existing D28-a question-deferral sequence already makes S01 decision authority the means of getting premature approval.
